Search summary of the Alpe d'Huez tourist-office ski-area page: 2,200 m vertical from Pic Blanc (3,330 m) down to l'Enversin d'Oz (1,135 m), the lowest point of the Grand Domaine; vertical is the published round figure (3,330 − 1,135 = 2,195). Alpe d'Huez village itself sits at about 1,860 m.

Search summary of the official SATA ski-area pages: 250 km of slopes, 111 runs, 67 lifts, top at Pic Blanc 3,330 m. Skiable area 840 ha (tourist-office ski-area page, search summary), converted to acres (840 ha ≈ 2,076 acres). Lift types, hourly capacity and a complete colour split were not published in the results (a summary listed 36 green, 29 blue and 16 black runs without the red count).

character: Alpe d'Huez is a sunny resort in the Oisans, linked with Auris-en-Oisans, Villard-Reculas, Oz-en-Oisans and Vaujany in a domain of about 250 km and 111 runs up to Pic Blanc (3,330 m). It is known for long descents from the Pic Blanc glacier, such as the Sarenne black run (reference).
learning: Reference: the village has beginner areas and many easy runs close to the accommodation; confirm beginner-lift access and lessons for 2026-27.

announcedOpening.text: Ski area open 5 Dec 2026 – 25 Apr 2027 (official ski-pass site); all linked villages (Alpe d'Huez, Auris, Oz-Vaujany, Villard-Reculas) open together.

source.note: France Montagnes 26-27 list: Alpe d'Huez opens Saturday 5 Dec 2026 ('dates announced by the resorts, subject to weather and snow conditions'). Matches the earlier search summary of the official SATA page (5 Dec 2026 – 25 Apr 2027).

announcedClosing.text: Ski area closes 25 Apr 2027 (official ski-pass site).

research.confidenceNotes: Web pages could not be fetched in this build, so every fact is from search summaries of the named pages (mostly the official SATA ski-pass site and the tourist office). Coordinates are reference data; weather points approximate; airport times are estimates. Adversarial re-check on 2026-10-03 could not open any cited page (WebFetch blocked by the egress proxy on every domain tried, web-search budget exhausted), so these search-summary facts remain unconfirmed at source; only internal consistency was checked (calendar weekdays, age bands, rate windows, unit conversion). 2026-10-03 CI-fetched pages: the France Montagnes 26-27 opening list confirms the 5 Dec 2026 opening; the official ski-pass overview page confirms 2026/27 season and annual passes (early booking before 1 Oct / 20 Nov) but shows no prices; the tourist-office homepage states 'more than 250 km of slopes'.
